Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

On your server — Audio: Urdu

videos.title: The Unusual Team
videos.overview: A trophy wife, a boxer, a wedding planner, and an ex-convict form an unlikely alliance, opening up a covert detective agency under the guise of a women’s clothing store.

videos.title: The Fight For A Cause
videos.overview: The Churails seek to hire like-minded women from the fringes of society for the agency in a bid to help their female clients fight infidelity. Zubaida is invited back home by her parents, but the Churails sense that all is not right. The ladies vow to expand their business beyond infidelity cases and help vulnerable women free of cost.

videos.title: A Gruesome Crime
videos.overview: The boundaries of law are crossed as the women begin dishing out social justice on their terms. The team disagrees on methods and the number of pro-bono cases they should take up. Sheila, one of the agency's hires, has her mother murdered, which leads some of the Churails to her native town in Hyderabad. But all is not as it seems.

videos.title: Batool's Blast From The Past
videos.overview: Batool's dark past comes to the fore as she begins the search for her missing daughter. The unexpected revelation of a cheating husband's truth leaves the Churails questioning if they should share their discovery with the client.

videos.title: The Churails in Danger
videos.overview: A botched case and the resulting police investigation forces the Churails to fight an angry mob outside their headquarters. The fate of 'Halal Designs' and the Churails hangs in the balance.

videos.title: The Much-Needed Reunion
videos.overview: Sara struggles in the aftermath of the fire, while Sheila, a former Churail, goes missing. The disbanded group must come together once again to find her. But larger forces are at play.

videos.title: Zubaida Goes Undercover
videos.overview: Batool meets another dead-end in her search for her daughter but learns more details about her past in the process. In her search for Sheila, Zubaida goes undercover at an elite party held for upcoming talent, despite strong retaliation from many team members.

videos.title: The Deadly Secret
videos.overview: Zubaida is kidnapped, and a deadly secret is revealed. With all the Churails now locked in a safe house, Jugnu escapes following a lead regarding Batool’s daughter. A key player in the racket is finally revealed.

videos.title: Zubaida's Rescue Mission
videos.overview: The Churails have to devise an elaborate plan to rescue Zubaida without raising suspicion, avoiding the watchful eyes of the guards. All hell breaks loose as the rescue mission comes to a head, and there are multiple casualties.

videos.title: The Animal Club
videos.overview: Sara and Jugnu uncover the dark history of the Animal Club, and in a shocking turn of events, the final player in the racket is revealed.
